headline: After single-stock leverage curbs, KOSDAQ leveraged products 'soar'… clear fund inflows
summary: KOSDAQ leveraged products led the weekly ETF gainers, with returns in the 60% range, after curbs on single-stock leveraged trading. Inflows into the funds were noted, with analysts watching for heightened volatility.
why: The KOSDAQ is South Korea's technology-focused junior stock market. Leveraged ETFs amplify daily index moves, so regulatory limits on leverage affect trading flows and volatility.
